خَرْجٌ [originally an inf. n.] Outgoings, disbursements, expenditure, or expenses; what goes out, or is expended, of a man's property; contr. of دَخْلٌ. (S, K.) ―
-b2- See also خَرَاجٌ, throughout. ―
-b3- Also, (S, L, K,) and ↓ خُرُوجٌ , (L,) Clouds when first rising and appearing: (S, L, K:) or the rain that comes forth from clouds: (Akh:) or the خُرُوج of clouds is their becoming extended, or expanded. (TA. [See 1.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
